root_cause.text: The `dma_ringalloc` function in the brcmsmac driver passes the requested `size` to `dma_free_coherent()` instead of the actual allocated size stored in `*alloced`, which can differ due to alignment adjustments made during the initial allocation.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff replaces `dma_free_coherent(di->dmadev, size, va, *descpa)` with `dma_free_coherent(di->dmadev, *alloced, va, *descpa)` in `drivers/net/wireless/broadcom/brcm80211/brcmsmac/dma.c`, and the commit message states that "dma_alloc_consistent() may change the size to align it. The new size is saved in alloced. Change the free size to match the allocation size."
